question: Where are a restaurant located no farther than 120 kilometers toward the southeast of Carysbrook Sports Complex, Fork Union, VA?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_DWithin( p.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Carysbrook Sports Complex%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 120000 ) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Carysbrook Sports Complex%' LIMIT 1 ), p.geometry )) BETWEEN 112.5 AND 157.5;
